name: WALL STANDING GLUTE KICKBACKS LEFT
introduce: Stand straight with your arms on a wall, then kick your left leg backwards and extend it as far as you can, meanwhile keep your legs and back straight and head up. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your leg straight when kicking it.
Exhale when kicking your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankle.
You should feel your glutes engage.
This exercise can really tone your glutes.
